highlights.title: Anthropic prepares for potential $2 trillion IPO valuation after reporting billions in revenue
highlights.description: Anthropic has filed to go public as it pursues a potential multitrillion-dollar valuation, reporting $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026. The company’s filing also warns that its AI safety measures may not prevent catastrophic risks. OpenAI and AI chipmaker Cerebras have also pursued public-market listings

highlights.title: Anthropic’s IPO May See CBA Sitting on Multi-Billion Windfall
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering may give Commonwealth Bank of Australia an opportunity to cash in on a stake it purchased in the artificial intelligence startup more than a year ago and whose valuation has ballooned.

highlights.title: Anthropic Brings Mega IPO to Australia’s AI-Starved Retail Crowd
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC will offer shares as part of its blockbuster initial public offering directly to Australian investors, bringing a fresh artificial-intelligence bet to a market still reeling from the high-profile collapse of a data center deal.

highlights.title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
highlights.description: Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

highlights.title: What Anthropic's IPO Means for the AI Trade
highlights.description: Anthropic is expected to raise more money in its initial public offering than any company in history and plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Its public market performance might cement or capsize Wall Street’s confidence in the AI boom at a moment when investors are increasingly anxious about the borrowing binge underpinning it. Matt Bloxham of Bloomberg Intelligence has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)
